name: L7905
description: Fixed -5V negative regulator from the 79xx family, the negative-rail partner to the 7805. The 79xx pinout is GND-IN-OUT, which is different from the 78xx (IN-GND-OUT). A classic wiring trap when building dual supplies.

TO-220.notes: TO-220, label toward you, leads down: GND-IN-OUT. Note the tab is connected to the INPUT on the 79xx, not ground.

typical_application: Negative rail of a split +-5V supply alongside a 7805. Use a 2.2uF tantalum (or 1uF) on the output as the datasheet recommends for stability.
gotchas: 79xx pinout is GND-IN-OUT, DIFFERENT from the 78xx IN-GND-OUT; the most common dual-supply mistake
the tab is connected to the INPUT on 79xx parts, not ground; isolate it from grounded heatsinks
79xx parts can be fussy about output capacitor type; follow the datasheet (often a tantalum)
input must be at least ~2V more negative than the output
